title: Closure of Stalls at Hawker Centres due to Drop in Business during COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Period
what_it_is: Closure of Stalls at Hawker Centres due to Drop in Business during COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Period

sections.label: Cooked food stallholders not operating
sections.summary: Since the circuit breaker began, about 20% to 30% of cooked food stallholders have chosen not to operate their stalls.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Since the start of the circuit breaker measures, we have observed that about 20% to 30% of cooked food stallholders have chosen not to operate their stalls.

sections.label: Food Delivery Booster Package extension
sections.summary: The Food Delivery Booster Package gives 5% off commission rates and 20% lower delivery costs, with about 600 applications and $500 assistance extended to end-June 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Food Delivery Booster Package by ESG was introduced at the start of the circuit breaker period so that F&B establishments, as well as our hawkers, can enjoy 5% off the prevailing commission rates charged by the major food delivery platforms and 20% lower delivery costs if they engage third party logistics players.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: As of today, some 600 applications have been received for this scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To facilitate this, we have decided to extend the availability of this $500 assistance by one month till the end of June 2020.

sections.label: Information package on delivery platforms
sections.summary: An information package will list food delivery platforms, third party logistics partners and newer operators, including models for aggregating orders within a centre.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In order to further facilitate this, we will be providing an information package that will include a non-exhaustive list of all the various food delivery platforms, third party logistics partners, as well as those that I had mentioned earlier, the newer, maybe smaller operators but newer models, in terms of where they can allow for aggregation of orders within a centre.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Instead, they charge delivery charges to the patrons, whereas some would charge a lower commission like 10% and then, co-funding of the delivery charges.

sections.label: Rental waivers and dishwashing subsidies
sections.summary: Rental waivers of 50% in June are provided, and table-cleaning and centralised dishwashing are subsidised so stallholders pay nothing into the extended circuit breaker period.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Beyond that, within the short term, as I have said, we are providing rental waivers, in fact, till June, 50% in June.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And then, we subsidise the table-cleaning and centralised dishwashing so that they do not have to pay at all into the extended circuit breaker period.
